{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Monster |version1 = Bearded |version2 = No beard |name = Bandit |image1 = [[File:Bandit (Pollnivneach, bearded).png|150px]] |image2 = [[File:Bandit (Pollnivneach, no beard).png|150px]] |release = [[4 April]] [[2005]] |update = Ali Morrisane and Pollnivneach |members = Yes |combat1 = 41 |combat2 = 56 |size = 1 |examine1 = Tough-looking. |examine2 = A vicious thief. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit1 = 7 |max hit2 = 9 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Slash]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 50 |hitpoints = 30 |att1 = 40 |att2 = 59 |str1 = 50 |str2 = 70 |def1 = 20 |def2 = 30 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 9 |strbns = 9 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 9 |dcrush = 8 |dmagic = 10 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |dropversion1 = Bearded |dropversion2 = No beard |id1 = 736,737 |id2 = 734,735 }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Bandit (Pollnivneach, bearded) chathead.png|left]] |version2 = [[File:Bandit (Pollnivneach, no beard) chathead.png|left]] }} '''Pollnivnian bandits''' can be found in northern [[Pollnivneach]], between the [[Pollnivneach general store.|general store]] and the [[Rug Merchant|rug merchant]]. They can be attacked, but are most popular as a target of [[blackjacking]], a high-intensity training method that offers the fastest [[experience]] from levels 45-49 and levels 65-91 [[Thieving]]. There are two types of bandits in Pollnivneach. The level 41 bearded bandits wield [[blackjack]]s, granting 65 experience and 40 [[coins]] per pickpocket, and the level 56 bandits have no beard, wield [[Steel scimitar|steel scimitars]], and grant 84.3 experience and 50 coins per pickpocket. In order to get the maximum experience rates, players must knock bandits out with blackjacks before pickpocketing them. This method requires near completion of the quest [[The Feud]], level 30 [[Thieving]], and the ability to kill a [[Safespot|safespottable]] level 70 [[bandit champion]]. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Bandit (Pollnivneach) |location = [[Pollnivneach]] |levels = 41, 56 |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:3354,y:2987|x:3354,y:2994|x:3354,y:3000|x:3357,y:3001|x:3360,y:2999|x:3361,y:3003|x:3362,y:2988|x:3367,y:2997|x:3371,y:2984 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Desert |dropversion = Bearded,No beard }} {{LocTableBottom}} ==Drops== ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ==Blackjacking== The probability to successfully knock out a bandit is independent of the blackjack used, and the same for both types of bandit (as well as for [[Menaphite Thug]]s). Knocking out either bandit rewards 10 Thieving experience. If the player has [[line of sight]] to a second bandit when attempting to knock one out, they will be unable to, with a chat message stating {{mes|Perhaps I shouldn't do this here, I think another bandit will see me.}} Attempting to knock them out while in combat also fails, producing the message {{mes|You can't knock-out the bandit during combat.}} {{DropLogProject|kills=30857735|success=yes}} {{Skilling success chart |label=Knock-Out chance |showbefore=no |label1=Bandit |low1=80 |high1=240 |req1=45 |color1=darkgoldenrod |image1=Willow blackjack.png }} ==Pickpocketing== Pickpocketing a bandit while they are awake rewards a coin pouch, but while they are knocked out coins are received directly instead. ===Bearded Pollnivnian Bandit=== {{Thieving info |version = Bearded |name = Bandit (bearded) |level = 45 |xp = 65 |type = Pickpocket |tool = [[Blackjack]] |dropversion = Bearded }} {{DropsTableHead|dropversion=Bearded}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Coins|quantity=40|rarity=Always|skill=Thieving}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Tertiary=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLineSkill |name=Rocky |quantity=1 |skill=thieving |rarity=1/256,086 |altrarity=1/254736 |altraritydash=yes |raritynotes= {{CiteTwitter |author=Mod Kieren |url=https://twitter.com/JagexKieren/status/780410304731709440 |date=26 September 2016 |archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104505 |archivedate=26 May 2020 |quote=Okay... first one!
